actionHints: A fast jab. Catches a Dodge as it recovers and interrupts a Grab.
Step aside. Slips a Grab and punishes it, and makes a slow Heavy whiff.
A throw. Catches a Heavy during its wind-up and goes straight through a Guard.
A slow, powerful blow. Breaks a Guard and is too heavy to Parry.
Raise your guard. Leaves a Parry nothing to deflect and blocks a Strike.
Deflect and hit back. Punishes a Strike and catches a Dodge.
